title: Isolation and Freezing of Human Peripheral Blood Mononuclear Cells
author: Efthymiou, Mureanu, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents at room temperature
steps.instruction: Keep Ficoll‑Paque PLUS (Cat No: 17144003) at 18 °C–22 °C and bring PBS/EDTA containing 2 % FBS to the same temperature.

steps.title: Load Ficoll into SepMate tube
steps.instruction: Invert the Ficoll‑Paque PLUS several times, then pipette 17 mL into the SepMate‑50 tube through the central hole so that the Ficoll sits just above the insert.

steps.title: Dilute whole blood 1:1
steps.instruction: Transfer whole blood to a sterile 50 mL Falcon tube, add an equal volume of PBS‑EDTA with 2 % FBS (e.g., 16.5 mL blood + 16.5 mL PBS‑EDTA + 2 % FBS for a total of 33 mL; if less blood is available, keep the 1:1 ratio), and mix gently by inversion.

steps.title: Add diluted blood to SepMate
steps.instruction: Keep the SepMate tube vertical and slowly pipette the diluted blood down the side of the tube, allowing it to mix with the density‑gradient medium above the insert; avoid pipetting directly through the central hole.

steps.title: Centrifuge for mononuclear separation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the SepMate tube at 1200 × g for 20 min at room temperature (18 °C–22 °C) with the brake set to 7 of 9.

steps.title: Collect mononuclear cell layer
steps.instruction: Aspirate part of the yellow plasma layer without disturbing the white mononuclear cell interface, then pour the top enriched MNC layer into a new 50 mL Falcon tube; do not hold the SepMate tube inverted for more than 2 s to avoid disrupting the filter.

steps.title: Register cryovials
steps.instruction: Scan and barcode the cryovials and record them as PBMC samples.

steps.title: Wash cells with RPMI
steps.instruction: Fill the 50 mL Falcon tube with RPMI 1640 medium (Thermo Fisher, Cat No: 733‑1690), mix gently, then centrifuge at 300 × g, 20 °C for 8 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS‑EDTA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 5–10 mL PBS‑EDTA containing 2 % FBS, mix, centrifuge at 300 × g, 20 °C for 8 min, and pour off the supernatant quickly without disturbing the pellet, removing as much liquid as possible.
